---
title: "Test Helpers"
author: "Tom Naber"
date: "`r format(Sys.Date(), '%B %d, %Y')`"
knit: (function(inputFile, encoding) { 
      source(here::here('Scripts','rmd_param_knitter.R')); 
      smart_knitter(inputFile, out_path = here::here("Output", "test.html"))})
output:
  html_document:
    theme: cosmo
    toc: true
    toc_float: true
    number_sections: true
    df_print: paged
    highlight: tango
    self_contained: true
    fig_width: 6.4
    fig_height: 4.8
    code_folding: hide
editor_options:
  markdown:
    wrap: 80
  chunk_output_type: console
params:
  research_data_folder: 
    label: "Research data folder"
    value: "local"
    input: select
    choices: ["local", "remote"]
    help: "Set location to load data from"
  save_figures:
    label: "Save figures"
    value: FALSE
  peak_definition:
    label: "Peak definition"
    value: "peak_to_trough"
    input: select
    choices: ["zero_to_peak", "peak_to_trough"]
  lower_peak_window:
    label: "Low limit peak window"
    value: 300
    input: slider
    min: 0
    max: 500
    step: 1
  upper_peak_window:
    label: "Upper limit peak window"
    value: 350
    input: slider
    min: 0
    max: 500
    step: 1
  reject_trials:
    label: "Filter out rejected trials"
    value: TRUE
  noise_level:
    label: "Noise floor"
    value: 0.09
    input: numeric
  startle_threshold:
    label: "Startle amplitude threshold (startles below this value are removed)"
    value: 0
    input: numeric
  remove_blocks:
    label: "Remove blocks up to this value"
    value: 0
    input: slider
    min: 0
    max: 6
    step: 1
  zero_non_startles:
    label: "Set non-startles to 0"
    value: TRUE
  zero_threshold_factor:
    label: "Set factor applied to the noise floor to determine threshold for zeroing non-startles"
    value: 1.5
    input: numeric
  excluded_ids:
    label: "List excluded IDs (comma separated)"
    value: "1-7-2-10-KO"
    input: text
---

# Set-up

## Set options & import sources

```{r setup, include=FALSE, cache = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(fig.width = 6.4,
                      fig.height = 4.8,
                      dpi = 300,
                      fig.retina = 1,
                      out.width = "100%",
                      out.height = "100%",
                      dev = "ragg_png")

knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = here::here())

options(contrasts = c("contr.sum", "contr.poly"))

library(ggplot2)
library(here)
library(sameplot)

source(here("Scripts", "universal_helpers.R"))
```

# Make plot

```{r}
p <- ggplot2::ggplot(mtcars, ggplot2::aes(wt, mpg)) + ggplot2::geom_point()
```

# Sameplot render (save and include)

```{r}
sameplot(p, file = file.path("Output", "plot.png"), save = TRUE)
```

# Knitr/RStudio backend render

```{r}
p
print(params$upper_peak_window)
```

# Render raw file absolutely

```{r, echo=FALSE, results="asis"}
knitr::asis_output(sprintf(
  '<img src="%s">',
  knitr::image_uri(here::here("Output", "plot.png"))
))
```
